card.name: Quantity words before water or food
card.fires_on: Small determiners or quantity words like "a", "small", or "fewer" right before an amount or vessel, mostly in administration directions (swallow whole with a glass of water; mix into a small amount of food).

modes.label: Swallow with a glass
modes.description: The word "a" after "swallow ... whole with", before glass of water.
modes.example: Swallow tablets whole with<< a>> glass of water.

modes.label: Mix in a small amount
modes.description: The word "small" before amount or cup when crushing or mixing a dose into liquid or food.
modes.example: the capsule contents may be administered with a<< small>> amount (1 to 2 teaspoons)

modes.label: Fewer inputs
modes.description: A comparative quantity word in non-drug text describing needing less of something.
modes.example: require<< fewer>> inputs of water, fertilizer, mowing

card.writes: It pushes toward words that continue a measured amount or container, and away from the word money.
card.plain: It fires on little words like "a" or "small" that come just before an amount of water or food in dosing directions.
